rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded Day 5 blastocyst with thinned zona, compact ICM, and cohesive multicellular TE consistent with the provided 3AA grade; minor speculative details like exact quadrant/debris prevent a perfect score.
Strongly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, PCOS, prior IVF outcomes, endometrial thickness, sperm motility, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates and recommendations generally supported by the case; slight uncertainty/speculation around fresh vs frozen and OHSS lowers the score slightly.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including SET for a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst and avoiding routine add-ons; minor deviations/speculative suggestions keep it from a 5.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, lifestyle modification, luteal support review, uterine cavity assessment, male-factor follow-up, metabolic optimization, and when to discuss PGT-A.
